fields.description:
## Context

WAGR-446 remains unchanged. This follow-up captures configuration/permission additions introduced by the current design.

## Requirements

* Keep reviewed Named Credential / External Credential / integration-user setup unchanged.
* Extend integration/system access to new approved Deal/Link integration fields.
* Normal users see Deal Status through the read-only display/formula field.
* The underlying Deal Status field is not writable through normal user FLS/UI paths.
* Use Permission Sets for practical action/button access distribution.
* Do not duplicate Custom Permission checks inside every lifecycle Flow unless a concrete bypass path requires one.
* Ensure system/integration automation can write the source Status field and CMS sync/request fields.
* Keep CMS sync/publication timestamps system-managed and normal-user read-only.
* Preserve configuration for enabled/send-off, Include Links, Include Test Records, timeout, retry settings, alert recipients and payload ceiling.

## Done when

Current reviewed connection continues to work and lifecycle/CMS stories have the access they need without reopening WAGR-446.
